name: Hollis Fong
life: “I still remember learning syncopation from spoons in a sink.” On Saturday, near the corner outside Coastal Barber, Hollis usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I only play on kitchen pots. The stool was higher than our worktop, so I stood up.
appearance: Hollis has a high puff tied with plain cord, a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, and a favorite piece of clothing, a black overshirt with pearl buttons. It usually goes with a replacement button a shade darker than the others. When somebody else has the floor, Hollis folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing.
personality: Likes beautiful, unnecessary things and gets cross with people who mistake poverty for a lack of taste. Hollis takes longer choosing a cheap birthday card than an expensive coat.
agenda: To try the stage kit again at kitchen height.
family: Ariel Sawyer is Hollis’s older relative by marriage. Hollis checks the date twice. Ariel brings something that can still be enjoyed tomorrow. Arrangements do change in their family. Taking a delay seriously without treating it as an insult took both of them years. Asked about *A last ship together*, Ariel says, “I had planned to sit in the cab alone and cry.”
connections: Sofia Yates. The kitchen percussionist and the teacher discover how to practice standing together.

reactions.situation: A child freezes halfway through the song
reactions.response: Hollis lets the beat drop out and waits for the child to choose whether to rejoin.

reactions.situation: Someone begins blaming the youngest worker for a missing item
reactions.response: Hollis brings the worker into the conversation and asks what they remember without feeding them a story.

reactions.situation: When a relative dismisses a little luxury
reactions.response: Hollis asks which ordinary pleasure the relative would give up first.
